Build `RetryingGateway`, which wraps any `NotificationAdapter` and also satisfies `NotificationAdapter`. Callers and the existing adapters need no changes. You adopt retries by writing `send_welcome(RetryingGateway(EmailAdapter("smtp")), to)`.
